verdict.rationale: Motion's core product directly matches this story: AI auto-schedules tasks into calendar time blocks around deadlines (motion-docs-10,12,17), highlights priorities (motion-docs-4), and reshuffles the whole day/week automatically when meetings run long or plans change (motion-docs-3,motion-docs-44), with proactive at-risk deadline warnings (motion-docs-11,39). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user corroboration of actual replanning accuracy in practice (community evidence pack only covers unrelated backend engineering complaints, not scheduling behavior).
